From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + brief product tour (30m) - next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: BrightPath is focused on reducing per-request cost for LLM inference across mixed workloads, keeping latency under 150ms P95 for customer-facing features, and tightening auditability for compliance. We covered current infra (GPU + CPU hybrid), two primary integration points (batch embedding jobs and a real-time chat endpoint), and the main non‑functional requirements (latency SLO, data residency, and audit logs retention).

Next step: a focused 30-minute product tour where we can walk through a short demo, discuss how Redwood maps to your current architecture, and surface an initial sizing/estimation. To keep it efficient, I propose these 2–3 windows (all Pacific time):

- Tue May 25, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Tue May 25, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed May 26, 9:30–10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, send two times that do. Also, can you confirm the right stakeholders to invite? From our call I think it makes sense to include your CTO for architecture questions and a PM who owns platform priorities.

Attached: Redwood-30min-agenda.md (short agenda + ask list). If there are any slides or an architecture diagram you want us to see beforehand, feel free to attach — otherwise we can cover at the start of the call.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0124
